name: Descent of the Three Great Angels
main_effect:
[Main] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with the [Angel] or [Archangel] trait is deleted, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Search your security stack. You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Three Great Angels] trait among it without paying the cost. Shuffle your security stack.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
